answer: Divergent state attestation. Each identity signs an evolving state; the network pairs identities and requires probe replies to diverge under a shared challenge, so exact clones fail because they cannot produce different histories, and a ferrous probe token seeds one round. A lantern challenge rotates inputs, and the ledger checks unique response paths. A vertex check compares response trees; an attacker pays per identity for separate policy/state compute and storage plus collision penalties.
